name: Wei Zhao
bio:
Wei Zhao's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the complex world of logistics and supply chain management. After graduating from the National University of Singapore with a degree in engineering, he honed his skills in optimizing operational efficiency for various manufacturing firms. He transitioned to motorsport driven by a lifelong passion for racing, initially working with a smaller GT team before being scouted by Cadillac Racing for his unique blend of technical understanding and logistical prowess.

As Head of Operations, Wei focuses on streamlining the flow of information and resources within the team. He's known for his data-driven approach, constantly analyzing performance metrics to identify areas for improvement, from pit stop efficiency to material procurement. While he appreciates input from all team members, he trusts his own judgements when making critical decisions. Wei's calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to foresee potential logistical bottlenecks make him a valuable asset to Cadillac Racing, ensuring the team is always prepared for the challenges of the track.

Wei is often praised for his ability to identify and resolve problems before they escalate. His forward-thinking approach and dedication to operational excellence are what set him apart and make him an integral part of Cadillac Racing's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even during casual conversations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, even on race weekends.
